rows.falsifier: Demonstration of a universal, context-independent error correction algorithm that successfully mitigates failures across heterogeneous tasks without introducing new failure modes.
rows.reason: New research on dependency-guided failure attribution (DeFA) confirms that reasoning errors are often trace-specific, limiting the efficacy of simple, universal correction mechanisms.
rows.statement: Automated reasoning models exhibit distinct safety failure profiles under adversarial pressure, preventing universal self-correction strategies; this is reinforced by the finding that specific error attribution is highly sensitive to cross-segment dependencies.
